name: Ferienwohnung Schwaiger
beschreibung: The Holiday Apartment Schwaiger is located in the municipality of Erl in the Tiroler Kaiserwinkl, directly on the border with Bayern. The quiet location on the slope of the Zahmer Kaiser ensures a relaxed atmosphere with panoramic views of the surrounding mountains. The holiday apartment offers guests a fully equipped kitchen, a modern bathroom, and cozy living areas. In summer, the surroundings are a paradise for hikers and mountain bikers who can use the trails in the Kaisergebirge Nature Reserve. In the winter months, the Zahmer Kaiser ski area as well as groomed winter hiking trails and cross-country ski trails are available. A cultural attraction is the internationally known Passionsspielhaus Erl, which hosts festivals and concerts. The convenient location near the Inntalautobahn also allows for comfortable day trips to Kufstein or to the Alpine metropolis Innsbruck.
